summary: Add teaching cards for all four isotope outcomes, which are the only gaps reported by the current gates.

improvements.why: The syllabus gate reports no teaching card for each of the four outcomes; the existing note, flashcards, misconceptions and question bank already cover their content.
improvements.what: Add one concise teaching card per outcome with a discover question that asks learners to infer the idea before the explanation: isotope definition from paired nuclides; top and bottom numbers in $^{x}_{y}\mathrm{A}$; equal electron configuration and chemical properties; different neutron counts, mass and density. Reuse the existing correct examples and wording, and add only content without changing existing entries.
